Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libhevc && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
bp=Path('Android.bp').read_text()
start=bp.index('cc_library_static {', bp.index('name: "libhevcenc"'))
end=bp.index('sanitize:', start)
block=bp[start:end]
import re
srcs=re.findall(r'"([^"]+\.c)"', block)
# Exclude arm-specific? block includes arm arch too because end after arch; collect until arch start
pre=block.split('arch:')[0]
srcs=re.findall(r'"([^"]+\.c)"', pre)
print(len(srcs))
print('\n'.join(srcs[:200]))
Path('/tmp/enc_srcs.txt').write_text(' '.join(srcs))
PY
wc -w /tmp/enc_srcs.txt
sed -n '400,432p' Android.bp
